usedFor: Shopify holds the store and its blog, PostFast holds the social calendar. When Shopify publishes a “New Blog Article”, PostFast can run “Create Post” to schedule it or save a draft for a social account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Blog Article” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in PostFast
bestTemplate.why: A published article is something worth sharing, and “Create Post” can schedule it with media and a first comment. “Abandoned Checkout” would turn a shopper's cart into a public post, which makes little sense.

watchOut: “New Blog Article” is a polling trigger, so PostFast hears about it on a schedule, not the moment the article goes live. Save the post as a draft if you want to read it first.
